verdict.rationale: Exa's core search API accepts natural-language queries directly (e.g. 'agtech companies in the US that raised Series A'), Websets are built from a natural-language query plus criteria, and Exa's MCP server lets AI assistants like Claude/Cursor/ChatGPT operate it purely via NL commands without code. This is well documented across docs and GitHub examples. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that NL commands reliably map to correct results (community reports show mixed accuracy, e.g. missed price enrichment and slow/stuck verification), and no first-party benchmark of NL-command success rate.
